notes: בְּתוֹךְ fuses to *through* under rule 30, headed on the construct noun, as the corpus fuses a preposition with תּוֹךְ or קֶרֶב in 27 units.

*the upper gate* writes one *the*, and rule 47 gives it to the article standing on the attributive rather than to the construct noun, a present article morpheme taking its English before a supplied one does. The same rule governs the two *side of the house* phrases of 2CH.23.10.
*unto the king's house* takes its supplied *unto* on the bare appositional nominal (rule 33) and puts the determiner on the possessor's article (rule 29).
